escenas.texto: Thirty videos. Over one hundred and seventy-one million views. One single week in Africa. Somewhere in this countdown, a channel with fewer than one hundred thousand subscribers is beating giants with millions. Where does it land? You will find out, one position at a time. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Africa edition: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because number one is not who you think.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Wednesday. Let's go.

We open with the ten most viewed videos of the week. And we start with a surprise. Number ten, from Tunisia, ZARUFA FF. A channel with about thirty-five thousand subscribers, and a video over one hundred and forty-one minutes long. A real marathon. Even so, in just one day, it passed four hundred and sixty-four thousand views. That is how this countdown begins.

Number nine, LevelLods, with “Spider-Man’s Epic Swing Through New York! Marvel’s Spider-Man 2”. Over five hundred and forty-four thousand views in just two days. And this is no short clip: it runs for more than sixty-one minutes, and people stayed to watch.

Climbing to number eight, Techys, with “We Used HACKS in Roblox Huss Valley...”. Over five hundred and sixty-six thousand views, and five hundred and seventeen comments. Roblox keeps pulling crowds in Africa too.

Number seven, and we cross the one million mark. From Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video posted five days ago. Over one million views. And here is the detail that matters: it has the best engagement rate on this list. Five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. All of that in a video over thirty-five minutes long.
Number six, from Algeria, Fawajir. This one is fast. Posted just one day ago, and it already has over one million views and over two thousand likes. One day. Remember that name.

Halfway there. Number five, from Senegal, Marodi TV Sénégal, with episode twenty of season two of “Jeux de dames”. Over one point four million views and more than one thousand comments, with episodes over thirty-seven minutes long. And this channel is not done with us today.

Number four, from Egypt, Mahmoud Zayed. A Short of just twenty-three seconds that passed three point two million views. But look at the comments: over eleven thousand. That number is going to matter very soon. Now, careful. Only three remain, and the jump from here is huge.

The podium. Bronze medal: SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over ten million views. And get this: it is a channel with about ninety-four thousand subscribers. Ten million views from a channel that size. Remarkable. But two videos still beat it.

Silver medal, from South Africa, Ryan HD, with “School VS Adult VS College.”. A Short of just ten seconds. Ten seconds, and over thirteen million views. A channel with more than eleven million subscribers, doing exactly what it does best. So who could possibly beat that?

Drum roll, please. The most viewed video in Africa this week. Number one: Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. Over thirty million views. Thirty million. It was the fastest-growing video on this list, at about one hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. And the most surprising part: it comes from a channel with about eighty-eight thousand subscribers. That is the channel we promised at the start. A true giant killer.

Views tell you who was watched. Comments tell you who started the conversation. The ten most commented videos. Number ten, from Egypt, JIGGSo_ar, with a video posted five days ago. Over one thousand comments and over one hundred and five thousand views.
Number nine, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd returns. Over one thousand comments on the same video that took number seven in views. Over thirty-five minutes long, and people stayed to talk about it.
Number eight, also from Egypt, HikaSIU, with a video posted four days ago. Over one thousand comments and over three hundred and fifty thousand views. Egypt is clearly dominating this conversation.

Number seven, from Senegal, Marodi TV Sénégal is back, now with episode twenty-one of “Jeux de dames”. Over one thousand comments and over one point four million views. Fans are not just watching, they are debating.

Number six, from Morocco, Mehdi Hilm, with a video posted three days ago. Over one thousand comments, with over one hundred and ten thousand views. For a video that size, that is a very active community.

Number five, Ahmed Sabiri Gaming. Posted just one day ago, and already over two thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nine out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And it is a channel with about one hundred and forty-nine thousand subscribers.

Number four, and a familiar name. SalesBendagra, bronze in views, now with over two thousand comments on “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over ten million views from a channel of about ninety-four thousand subscribers. Now, the podium of the conversation.

Bronze medal, from Tunisia, Ury 2. A channel with about eighty-eight thousand subscribers, and a video that collected over three thousand comments, with more than four hundred and fifty-two thousand views. Small channel, huge conversation.

Silver medal, Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. The most viewed video of the week also passed six thousand comments. And yet, it is not number one here. One video got people talking almost twice as much.

Number one most commented. From Egypt, Mahmoud Zayed. Remember those comments we pointed out at number four in views? Over eleven thousand comments, on a Short of just twenty-three seconds, with over three point two million views. Twenty-three seconds that made all of Africa talk.
One list left, the one that measures love: the ten most liked videos. Number ten, from Egypt, LeOniDeS, with a video posted two days ago. Over fifteen thousand likes.

Number nine, from Egypt, BEPO FF. Posted just one day ago, and already over twenty-one thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: twelve out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. Twelve out of every hundred. Impressive.
Number eight, from Tunisia, Ury 2 again. Bronze in comments, and now over twenty-five thousand likes. A channel of about eighty-eight thousand subscribers showing up on two lists.
Number seven, from Senegal, Marodi TV Sénégal, with episode twenty of “Jeux de dames”. Over twenty-five thousand likes and over one point four million views. Three appearances today for this channel.
Number six, from Egypt, HikaSIU. Over twenty-eight thousand likes, with over three hundred and fifty thousand views, in a video over twenty-two minutes long.
Number five, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd. Over forty-nine thousand likes, and over one million views. This video is on all three lists this week.
Number four, from Egypt, Mahmoud Zayed. The king of comments also collected over fifty thousand likes. But from here up, the numbers explode. The next video has more than six times as many likes.
Bronze medal, from South Africa, Ryan HD, with “School VS Adult VS College.”. Over three hundred and twenty-two thousand likes, on a Short of just ten seconds. And there are still two above it.

Silver medal, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over four hundred and seven thousand likes. A channel with about ninety-four thousand subscribers, on the podium of two lists this week. Only one video got more love than this.

And the most liked video in Africa this week. Number one: Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. Over four hundred and forty-one thousand likes. Number one in views, silver in comments, and number one in likes. A channel with about eighty-eight thousand subscribers, at the top of Africa. What a week.

And some news: starting week forty-five we add TikTok. The ten most viral TikTok videos of the week, right here too. Don't miss it. And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Europe. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Africa every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
